chapter: Starting out in New Orleans and Chicago
title: First professional job with Chris Kelly and Sweet Black in New Orleans
summary: Williams played with Chris Kelly in a piano, trumpet and drums trio for Sweet Black on Franklin Street, his first professional work, with drummer Papa Crutcher.
